Welcome to the office of the
wood county recorder
Thank you for visiting the website of the Wood County Recorder. Here you will find many useful resources and information about the functions and requirements of the office. So please take a minute and browse the site to learn about this important county office.
As always the staff in the office is here to assist you in any way they can. So if you have questions or concerns please feel free to contact a friendly, knowledgeable staff member or me directly at crose@woodcountyohio.gov.
Thank you,
Connor Rose
Wood County Recorder

Search options
Adaptable Visual Access
The AVA search engine provides public access to the Wood County Recorder’s INDEX information in an easy-to-use, online format. The record INDEX is electronically available from 1980. Index data displayed is delayed approximately one day from the date it is indexed.
search now
Laredo Anywhere Search
Document images are available through the Laredo Anywhere Search option. To gain access, you must contact the office to complete an account request form. This account is intended for high-volume, professional use.
Search Now
Ameriscan Imaging Services
Documents-On-Demand (DOD) is AmeriScan’s cloud-based document center, designed to provide convenient access to records anytime, anywhere. Use this database to search and view all physical book indexes maintained by the Wood County Recorder’s Office quickly and efficiently.
